sentences.text: The documents do not state a specific pre-payment penalty for gold loans.

For loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, paragraph 261(5) says that in cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

The documents mention 2% of the principal outstanding in one Home Loan Agreement and 3% of the principal outstanding in a copy of that agreement, but they do not identify either charge as applying to gold loans.

missing.searched: searched the provided evidence and rule findings for any gold-loan-specific pre-payment charge or penalty amount
